summary: Implement direct PostgreSQL reads in PostgresSourceEvidenceRepository for cross-process evidence visibility across scheduler and API server without process restart while preserving strict tenant isolation.
diagnosis: In qualification-37678408482 L4 persona teaching run, training failed 'source DatasetVersion authority rejected: exactly one source evidence bundle must bind the selected connector run'. PostgresSourceEvidenceRepository loaded in-memory state only at __init__; writes upserted to PostgreSQL but getters/listers inherited InMemoryEvidenceRepository, so separate scheduler writes were invisible to the running API server process.
fix: PostgresSourceEvidenceRepository implements scoped _read_one, _read_many, and _read_by_dedupe querying PostgreSQL source_evidence with tenant-isolated WHERE clauses and in-memory fallback on connection failure. API server observes committed scheduler source records, items, bundles, and knowledge objects across processes without restart.
